info.name: Liora FastAPI — read-only live checks
info.description: Actual backend health, OpenAPI, authorization-boundary and routing checks. All requests are GET. No credentials required; no database mutations or emails. Run with a DEV/STAGE/PROD environment. See README for private-route DNS handling that preserves TLS/SNI.

exec: pm.test("OpenAPI contract has users, items and login", function () { const p = pm.response.json().paths; ["/api/v1/users/me", "/api/v1/items/", "/api/v1/login/access-token"].forEach(x => pm.expect(p).to.have.property(x)); });
